fusions.name: Tine Scrape
fusions.desc: A short drag of the head that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweep Together
fusions.desc: Sweeps the head around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each enemy spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Long Handle
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Windrow Tally
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, you recover 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
